736ff79015a5bbc0.title: Vienna Royal Orchestra: Viva Mozart 270
736ff79015a5bbc0.desc: Matthew Busse, Conductor Tian Jiang,Piano Patrick Rafter, Violin Shay Mowbray, piano Anson Wong, piano From Carnegie Hall to Jacobs Music Center... Following its New York performance this summer at Carnegie Hall, the Vienna Royal Orchestra brings its VIVA MOZART 270 celebration to Cerritos Center for the Performing Arts in Los Angeles area. This special concert honors the 270th anniversary of the birth of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart, one of history's most beloved and influential musical geniuses. Audiences will enjoy an inspiring program of Mozart's timeless masterpieces, performed by distinguished musicians from Europe and the United States. Internationally celebrated pianist Tian Jiang appears as soloist in Mozart's Piano Concerto No. 23 in A Major, K. 488. Praised as "a thoughtful interpreter" by The New York Times and "a deeply persuasive Mozartean" by The Los Angeles Times, he is recognized for performances that combine poetic artistry, technical mastery, and expressive depth.

7392ee6807e3f3a2.title: Bad Gyal - Más Cara World Tour 2026
7392ee6807e3f3a2.desc: Bad Gyal has established herself as one of the most influential artists in global urban music. With 46 Platinum and 13 Gold certifications, she’s built a distinct sonic identity that blends urban genres with Caribbean rhythms, paired with a strong visual and conceptual approach that has redefined her place in today’s music landscape. Her debut album, La Joia (Interscope/UML, 2024), marked a major turning point and confirmed her global reach: it racked up millions of streams on its first day, earned Gold certification from the RIAA in the U.S. within weeks of release, and hit No. 1 on the sales charts in Spain. In 2026, Bad Gyal released her second studio album, Más Cara (March 6, 2026), a project that signals a new creative chapter and expands her sonic universe even further. Executive produced by Cromo X, the album leans deeper into Caribbean influences, drawing from reggaeton, R&B, dancehall, merengue house, Jamaican shatta, and Haitian kompa. It is preceded by standout singles such as “Da Me,” her first solo track after an extended period focused on collaborations, followed by “Última Noche” (with Ozuna) and “Fuma.” The album tour launched on March 20 at Palau Sant Jordi in…
